test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S, T and U are six friends sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table in a cafe. S is seated third to the right of U. Q is the immediate neighbour of U and P. T is seated to the immediate left of S. Who are the immediate neighbours of R ?
solution:
Given → Six friends P, Q, R, S, T and U sitting around a circular table, facing the Centre.

1) S is seated third to the right of U

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8429633cc5a0205f18ad51625426dc76642b3a4def87d1091f9be62a13390acb.png] 

2) T is seated to the immediate left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c3bfab055f23377d1dc18415e757e3b5e9898af901fc6e07adf9d23212c0e6e.png] 

3) Q is the immediate neighbour of U and P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fd047092734ea7456dc613bab23033606fe17513314899d071cdc57a30eb24d.png] 

Therefore, it is established that **U and T is immediate neighbour of R.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"****U and T"**.
